game_title: Frequency Bazaar – Cloud Sea Overlook Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Frequency Bazaar: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Count how often each item appears using a dictionary. Each round, a new oxygen tanks challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the tally value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 240 points of oxygen tanks by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 240, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 7 (applied tier): Frequency Bazaar
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Frequency Bazaar' (Week 8 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tally changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 240 within 67 seconds.
